title: Villarroel approached by people she suspects have intelligence backgrounds

tellings.quote: I have been approached by some people I suspect have it.

plain: In 2025, in Stockholm, the astronomer Beatriz Villarroel says people she suspects have intelligence backgrounds have approached her. Villarroel studies old sky images and speaks of huge numbers of unexplained objects around Earth. She tells this from her own experience, which suggests her research has caught the attention of spy agencies.
